hard_negative_scenarios.coverage: local and smaller subgroup denominators, rate units, footnoted denominators and labels, weighted/adjusted/multiple-response/missingness cues, ragged rows
missing stub and ragged rows, local denominators, footnoted headers and cells, repeated smaller-denominator scope notes
invalid numeric domains, multiple-response/available-case/changing-denominator and unknown footnotes, unsafe row or table cues, referenced cells
unproven or overlapping exclusions, unit and group mismatch, synthetic multi-exclusion ambiguity, non-JATS input
multiple database and later-stage scope, unlabelled/non-review counts, malformed and oversized operands, image-only flow with no OCR
adjusted/missing/reversed OR direction, zero cells, missing timepoint, weighted context, CI text, noninteger counts, multiple outcome rows
SEM ambiguity, weighted/adjusted/repeated/transformed values, footnotes and cross-references, missing or duplicate columns, unit/time scope, oversized numbers, unreliable grid, non-JATS input

limitations: Counts are explicit synthetic/unit input scenarios in regression tests, not independent papers or estimates of real-world false-positive rates.
The SD/SE/n screen is experimental and has no correction-backed positive in the source corpus.
Rate recomputation and source-mapped cross-section identity are not implemented detectors and are not included as active-family regression counts.
